versions.changelog:
- Now only activates via the explicit /djtu-vehicle-eng-thesis-check command; no longer responds to generic phrases.
- Clarified activation scope to prevent accidental triggering on unrelated requests.
- Updated documentation to reflect new command-only activation and stricter workflow boundaries.
- Section numbering in .docx output is now preserved as-is from Markdown headings (no auto-numbering).
- All workflow steps, validation checks, and formatting notes remain unchanged.

Initial release of the DJTU Vehicle Engineering Thesis Checker & Formatter skill:

- Validates Vehicle Engineering theses for compliance with DJTU format rules.
- Guides users through environment setup with strict dependency and installation protocols.
- Checks drafts for cover page details, section order, heading hierarchy, captions, citation style, abstract and total length, and glossary terms.
- Converts validated Markdown drafts to properly formatted .docx files, applying official margin, font, and spacing standards.
- Relies on internal reference files for formatting specs, terminology, and examples.
- Enforces safe and consistent workflow through clear STOP instructions and user prompts during setup.
